variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants back the amulet the Urchins of the old barrow stole from the mill.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Have you seen them? Nasty little thieves, ran off toward the ford? No? Oh, bother!

The Urchins got into the mill last night and took my amulet, the one with the blue stone. They've a hole in the old barrow, east of the ford. I wouldn't set foot in there for all the flour in Brackenford!

Would you get it back for me, kind sir? I'd pay you for your trouble.

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Well! I see how it is. Off with you, then!

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Oh, those wretched Urchins! Have you got my amulet yet?

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My amulet! Oh, you found it! Bless you, bless you! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Recover Wenna's amulet from the Urchins.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Wenna's amulet from the Urchins.

variants.specifics: Kroth: Edda the Dowser's magic Dowsing Rod was stolen by the Urchins of the Gloom Hole, up the east tunnel.

offer.speaker: Edda
offer.text:
Thieves! Thieving little Urchins! They crept in while I was sleeping and took my Dowsing Rod right off the wall!

Without it I'm just an old woman poking at rocks. They live in the Gloom Hole, up the east tunnel past the slag heaps.

Will you get my rod back for me, young sir? I'll make it worth your while.

refusal.speaker: Edda
refusal.text: Hmph! Then go away and let me be miserable.

reminder.speaker: Edda
reminder.text: Did you get my Dowsing Rod back? Hurry, before those Urchins break it!

completion.speaker: Edda
completion.text: My rod! You found my rod! Bless you, bless you! Please, take this old Spell Book as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Edda
after.text: Thank you again! I'm off to find some silver!

journal.text: Retrieve Edda's Dowsing Rod from the Urchins in the Gloom Hole.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Edda's Dowsing Rod from the Urchins in the Gloom Hole.

variants.specifics: Gloam: Fennick, the village lookout; the Imps of the Rotten Oak flew off with his Spyglass.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Those wretched Imps! They flew right in my window and made off with my Spyglass!

How am I to keep watch now? Without it I can't see the Undead coming till they're halfway up the ladders! The Imps nest in the Rotten Oak, west across the bog.

Would you get my Spyglass back for me, brave Adventurer? I'd make it worth your while.

refusal.speaker: Fennick
refusal.text: Very well. But don't blame me when the Undead walk right in!

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Have you got my Spyglass yet? I can't see a blessed thing out there!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: My Spyglass! You found it! Ha, ha! Now let those Undead try to sneak up on Gloam! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Fennick
after.text: Thanks again, kind sir! I can see clear across the swamp now!

journal.text: Recover Fennick's Spyglass from the Imps in the Rotten Oak.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Fennick's Spyglass from the Imps in the Rotten Oak.

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Yorrin, the old lookout on the battlements, lost his Spyglass to the Imps of the Rookery.

offer.speaker: Yorrin
offer.text:
Thieves! Flying thieves! A pack of Imps swooped down on the battlements and snatched my Spyglass right out of my hands!

Without it I can't see the moor at all. If Malgrith's Undead march on us, nobody will know till they're knocking at the gate!

The Imps nest in the Rookery, the old tower west of the keep. Will you get my Spyglass back?

refusal.speaker: Yorrin
refusal.text: Very well. I'll find someone braver, I suppose.

reminder.speaker: Yorrin
reminder.text: Have you got my Spyglass? Those Imps could drop it anywhere!

completion.speaker: Yorrin
completion.text: My Spyglass! You found it! Bless you, kind sir! Now I can keep watch on the moor again. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Yorrin
after.text: Thanks again, kind sir! I can see clear across Kragmoor now.

journal.text: Recover Yorrin's Spyglass from the Imps in the Rookery.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Yorrin's Spyglass from the Imps in the Rookery.

variants.specifics: Ostra: Hulda, an old fishwife, lost her magic amulet to the Urchins of the caves under Black Cliff.

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text:
Thieves! Nasty little thieves! The Urchins crept down from the caves under Black Cliff last night and took my magic amulet right off my neck while I slept!

I can't go up there, not with my bad knees and the Undead about.

Would you get it back for me, kind sir? I'd be ever so grateful.

refusal.speaker: Hulda
refusal.text: Well! I never! Some hero you are.

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: Have you got my amulet yet? Those Urchins are a sneaky lot, you know.

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: My amulet! Oh, you found it! Bless you, bless you! Here, take these. It isn't much, but it's all an old fishwife has to give.

journal.text: Recover Hulda's amulet from the Urchins of Black Cliff.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Hulda's amulet from the Urchins of Black Cliff.

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Madame Grisella, the fortune teller, lost her crystal ball to Imps who carried it to the old quarry.

offer.speaker: Grisella
offer.text:
Ahhh! I knew you would come! I saw it in my crystal ball... before those wretched Imps stole it.

They flew in my window last night and carried it off to the old quarry north of town. I can't tell anybody's fortune without it!

Will you bring back my crystal ball, kind stranger? I will make it worth your while.

refusal.speaker: Grisella
refusal.text: Very well. But I see bad luck in your future, stranger. Very bad luck!

reminder.speaker: Grisella
reminder.text: Have you found my crystal ball? Hurry, before those Imps break it!

completion.speaker: Grisella
completion.text: My crystal ball! Oh, you wonderful creature! I see great things ahead for you... great things! Please, take this spell book as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Grisella
after.text: Thanks again, kind stranger! The spirits are smiling on you today.

journal.text: Recover Madame Grisella's crystal ball from the Imps in the old quarry.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Madame Grisella's crystal ball from the Imps in the old quarry.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Elko the Lookout: Urchins from the Ice Caves stole his magic spyglass off the north wall.

offer.speaker: Elko
offer.text:
Blast it all! How am I supposed to watch the pass now?

The Urchins crept up the north wall last night and made off with my spyglass! A magic one, it is. They live down in the Ice Caves below the wall.

Without it, Kolgrath's Undead could be at the gate before anybody sees them! Will you get it back for me, young sir?

refusal.speaker: Elko
refusal.text: Bah! Then we're as good as blind up here.

reminder.speaker: Elko
reminder.text: Did you find my spyglass? I can't see a thing up here!

completion.speaker: Elko
completion.text: My spyglass! Ha, ha! I can see all the way to Kel Dorran again! Thank you, lad. Here, take this for your trouble.

after.speaker: Elko
after.text: Thanks again, lad! Nothing gets past old Elko now.

journal.text: Recover Elko's spyglass from the Urchins in the Ice Caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Elko's spyglass from the Urchins in the Ice Caves.

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Thessa the smith's magic gloves were stolen down her chimney by Imps, who nest in the Cinder Caves north of town.

offer.speaker: Thessa
offer.text:
Thieves! Nasty little flying thieves! The Imps came down my chimney and stole my magic gloves right off the anvil!

Without them I can't touch the hot iron, and the whole town needs swords with the Ogres on the mountain. The Imps nest in the Cinder Caves, north of the town wall.

Will you bring my gloves back, kind sir? I'll make it worth your trouble.

refusal.speaker: Thessa
refusal.text: Oh, fine! I'll just burn my fingers then!

reminder.speaker: Thessa
reminder.text: My gloves! Have you got my gloves?

completion.speaker: Thessa
completion.text: My gloves! Oh, you found them! Now I can get back to work at last! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Thessa
after.text: Thanks again for my gloves, brave Adventurer!

journal.text: Retrieve Thessa's magic gloves from the Imps in the Cinder Caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Thessa's magic gloves from the Imps in the Cinder Caves.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Old Thurl, deaf without it, lost his ear trumpet to the Imps of Gallow Rock south of town.

offer.speaker: Thurl
offer.text:
EH? Speak up! SPEAK UP!

It's no good, I can't hear a blessed thing. Those Imps flew down from Gallow Rock and snatched my ear trumpet right out of my hand!

You'll fetch it back for me, won't you, young sir? I'll make it worth your while!

refusal.speaker: Thurl
refusal.text: WHAT? No? Bah! Nobody listens to me anymore!

reminder.speaker: Thurl
reminder.text: Did you get it? My trumpet? EH?

completion.speaker: Thurl
completion.text: My trumpet! Ahhhh, I can hear the birds again! Thank you, young sir, thank you! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Thurl
after.text: No need to shout, I can hear you fine now!

journal.text: Retrieve Thurl's ear trumpet from the Imps of Gallow Rock.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Thurl's ear trumpet from the Imps of Gallow Rock.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Granny Orla's Dowsing Rod was stolen by the Imps living in the old windmill west of town.

offer.speaker: Granny Orla
offer.text:
Oh, it's terrible, terrible! Those wretched Imps have been nesting in the old windmill west of town, and last night they crept in and stole my Dowsing Rod!

Without it I can't find water for the new wells, and the Ogres have fouled the old ones. Will you get it back for me, young sir? I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Granny Orla
reminder.text: Have you got my Dowsing Rod? Those Imps will break it, I just know it!

completion.speaker: Granny Orla
completion.text: My Dowsing Rod! Oh, bless you, bless you! Now we'll have water again. Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Recover Granny Orla's Dowsing Rod from the Imps in the old windmill.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Granny Orla's Dowsing Rod from the Imps in the old windmill.
